methods.adr: All image-aligned A32 ADD/SUB immediate PC source; arithmetic target within family.
methods.literal_loads: All image-aligned A32 word LDR PC-relative literal with immediate offset; loaded address in family.
methods.relative_words: All image-aligned words interpreted modulo2^32 as displacement from their own address, next word, or address+8; candidates only.
methods.extended_mov_pairs: Same-register MOVW followed by MOVT97..1024bytes away; includes data and clobbered-register false positives; manual validation required.
methods.limits: Not all address constructions, unaligned records, Thumb instructions, compression or runtime-built pointers are covered. No positive search hit alone establishes a code reference.

local_constant_search.limits: Linear local constant propagation, not CFG or symbolic execution. Conditional definitions invalidated; jumps/calls clear state. Does not cover arbitrary register arithmetic, distant control-flow paths or Thumb.

scope: Bounded static candidate searches. No firmware execution, camera, MMIO, pixel arithmetic, or proven WBLV register-read edge.
limits: Candidate counts include false positives and non-code data.
An exact address match alone does not establish a code reference.
The three exact long MOVW/MOVT pairs were rejected by separate instruction review; this search does not itself perform that dataflow proof.
The relative-word exact match lacks a proven consumer.
No arbitrary computed-pointer, Thumb or complete control-flow analysis is claimed.
